star_2026_photonuclear_slope.scope: Published derived-data consistency fit, correlated normalization and assumed nuisance correlation

star_2025_dilepton_shape.method: Center-bin approximate M^1.5 exp(-M/T) fit, diagonal errors

new_physics_claim_status: NOT DEMONSTRATED. Formal falsification gates and published benchmarking improved; source data quality reviewed; original controlled physical measurement and independent replications remain absent.

followup_exploratory_novelty_screen_2026.methodology: WLS and leave-one-centrality-out; assumed systematic cross-bin correlation at 0, 0.5, 0.9
followup_exploratory_novelty_screen_2026.key_result: One-parameter amplitude rescaling of UrQMD gives factor ~2.344; extra model complexity not established as necessary.
followup_exploratory_novelty_screen_2026.important_limit: This is not a confirmatory p value; these five points were seen before choosing models and exact covariance is unknown.

forward_energy_scan_benchmark.qualification: No independent 19.6 GeV Ru/Zr experimental measurement was available from the sources checked; full model uncertainty missing.

critical_current_blockers: New physics has not been demonstrated; direct calibrated original RF measurements absent
No independent experimental measurement of energy-scan isobar ratio at 19.6 GeV verified
Published five-point STAR discrepancy can be described by simple UrQMD amplitude rescaling; no unique microphysical inference
Full bin-to-bin covariance, modern alternative QCD model comparisons, external scientific replication required
Latest complete 66-file snapshot is same-device root-partition recovery, not independent off-device backup

new_primary_sources.finding: Charge-conjugation-odd conserved-charge flow observables already established in external theory; not WorldShepherd novelty
Receiver nonlinearities are a known uncertainty source in VNA measurements
Measurement calibration and cable/system uncertainty prior art

hepdata_quality.reason: All-zero/constant groups and hidden zero uncertainties; flag potential plotting placeholders; do not presume publication error

synthetic_rf_test_design.meaning: Simulation statistical sensitivity only, not actual RF performance; unknown drift, calibration, phase and real hardware artifacts

model_target_screen.source: STAR baryon Figure 4 and source UrQMD/nuclear-overlap model
model_target_screen.outcome: Centrality refinement alone at assumed 0.15 R absolute new-data uncertainty yields <2 sigma separation of fitted model alternatives across correlation sensitivity scenarios.
